✨ JPG + DNG (Recommended): Instant shareable graded JPGs while preserving lossless compressed DNG negatives for darkroom grading.
⚡ JPG Only: Saves maximum storage, ideal for everyday snapshots (no DNG negatives for darkroom lossless re-grading).
🎞️ DNG Only: Pure digital negatives, ready to be graded in Darkbag Playground or desktop software.
Film simulation LUTs must be mapped from a specific Log transfer curve to accurately render colors. Pairing them on import allows Darkbag to auto-switch the matching Log curve in the viewfinder.
Tip: If you do not have LUT files now, tap Next to skip. Darkbag will use the built-in cinematic film tone curve.
📷 P&S Minimal Layer: Clean viewfinder with focal length and shutter only, focused on street framing.
🎞️ FILM Simulation Layer (Recommended): Viewfinder includes Film Recipe capsule, Half-frame & Multi-cam modes, and dynamic HDR+ underexposure.
🎛️ PRO Manual Layer: Unlocks manual dials (ISO, Shutter speed, Manual focus) and focus peaking highlight.
